name: OpenMontage
title_zh: 把AI编程助手变成全能视频制作工坊
tagline_zh: 12条生产管线、100+工具、700+技能文件，开源免费。让Claude/Cursor直接产出成片。
tagline_en: 12 pipelines, 100+ tools, 700+ skill files, open-source. Turn Claude/Cursor into a full video studio—no more.
desc_en: World's first open-source, agentic video production system. 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools, 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files. Turn your AI coding assistant into a full video production studio.
why_zh: 不是单个技能，而是整套生产知识库。Agent按管线调度工具，从脚本到渲染全自动，工程化程度远超零散插件。
why_en: Not a skill but a production OS. Agents orchestrate tools across pipelines—script to render—far beyond scattered plugins.
limit_zh: 仅适配支持MCP的编程助手（Claude/Cursor等）；需自行安装ffmpeg、blender等外部依赖。
limit_en: Requires MCP-capable coding assistant (Claude/Cursor); external deps like ffmpeg/blender needed; output ends at edit timeline—color & mix stay manual.
